title: Dengue and severe dengue
summary: Common symptoms can include fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, nausea or vomiting and rash. Severe dengue can involve respiratory distress, major bleeding or shock and needs urgent care.

title: Antimicrobial resistance
summary: Misuse and overuse of antimicrobials can contribute to antimicrobial resistance. Antibiotics should be used only when appropriate and according to a qualified clinician's advice.

summary: India's National Immunization Schedule provides milestone-based vaccination guidance for children and pregnant mothers. Users should confirm due doses with an authorized vaccination centre.

title: Migraine and other headache disorders
summary: Headache disorders are common neurological disorders. Recurrent headaches can affect quality of life and may need appropriate assessment and care.

title: Diabetes
summary: Diabetes is a chronic condition involving raised blood glucose. Healthy diet, physical activity and appropriate clinical care can help prevent or delay complications.

title: Hypertension
summary: Hypertension means persistently raised blood pressure. Many people have no symptoms, so blood pressure measurement is important for detection and assessment.

title: Asthma
summary: Asthma is a chronic lung disease that can cause cough, wheezing, shortness of breath and chest tightness. Symptoms can worsen and may require emergency care when severe.

title: Cardiovascular diseases
summary: Cardiovascular diseases include disorders of the heart and blood vessels. Chest discomfort, breathing difficulty, light-headedness or fainting can occur in acute events and need prompt medical attention when severe.

title: Low back pain
summary: Low back pain can be acute, sub-acute or chronic and may affect movement and quality of life. Assessment is important when pain persists, worsens or has concerning associated features.
